title: Check captions of videos
user_impact: Deaf or hard-of-hearing users cannot perceive spoken content.
technical_impact: A rendered <video> has a <track kind="captions"> or kind="subtitles" (or a <track> without kind, which HTML reads as subtitles), but none of its files loads from the page origin as a caption format (.vtt or .srt), or the page embeds a third-party player (YouTube, Vimeo and similar), so spoken content may have no text equivalent. When every track of a video has no src or the page origin answers with an error or with no caption file, the video has no working captions: a review hint, like a missing track. A track on another origin or beyond the check budget and a third-party player stay an untested manual-check note, because the tool cannot see those captions. A video without such a track is reported as media/video-captions-missing instead.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) (H95, G87, F8); HTML §4.8.11.11 track
checks.applicability:
Pages with a rendered native <video> that has a caption or subtitle <track>
child (kind "captions" or "subtitles", ASCII case-insensitive and untrimmed, or
no kind at all: the HTML missing value default is subtitles; an invalid value,
"" or " captions" included, is metadata and does not count), or with a known
video-platform embed iframe (YouTube, Vimeo and similar).
A video without such a track is media/video-captions-missing (#1182); like that
rule, a muted video without controls and a video under aria-hidden="true" are
left out, so the two rules split the videos by track presence and none is
reported by both.
checks.expectation:
Pass (positive signal, no finding) only when every such video has a caption
track whose src resolves same-origin as a caption file (.vtt/.srt or a vtt
content type) and the page embeds no third-party player. A video whose caption
tracks all fail on the page origin (no src, an error status, an answer that is
no caption file) has no working captions, the same as a missing track: one
page-level REVIEW naming those videos (decision of 2026-11-23 on #1182). A
track on another origin, a caption track beyond the probe budget of 10 checks,
a request without an answer (HEAD refused with 405/501 is retried as GET) or a
third-party embed stays undecided: one page-level UNTESTED note, since captions
may exist in ways the tool cannot see. Never a violation. A video with one
failed and one undecided track is undecided. A page whose videos all lack a
caption track is not applicable here; a video in a hidden panel is not
presented in this state.
